stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"The page says its data is updated monthly, yet the figures are as of September, in November.","where":"the data date at the top","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: Fee shown is a 2025 average, not what the reader would actually be charged
Guaranteed-return (ביטוחן מבטיח תשואה) tracks show only 'לא דווח' and nothing says whether one can join
The '123 מקור / מחושב / הזנה' colour legend is confusing and its relevance unclear
Orange box says the authority's data hasn't been updated since September 2026, which worries the reader, and it clashes with 'נתונים נכון ל־03.11.2026' at the bottom
Filter labels like אשראי ואג"ח, אג"ח ממשלות and the הלכה filters are meaningless jargon
Table is very long (18 screens) to hunt through
Ayalon block is all 'עוד לא דווח' / 'חדש' and useless
Footnotes are only half helpful, and 'PF-06' is unexplained
The turquoise 'קופה' number column has no clear purpose
Ring charts repeat the numbers next to them
Dotted purple underlines on the numbers give no hint what clicking does
Share/foreign-currency exposure above 100% isn't explained and may be dangerous
A negative 'from deposits' fee with a warning sign is unexplained
The page never shows in money whether the fee from savings or from deposits hurts more
'פחות מ־3 שנים' in the return column looks like an error
Unclear difference between 'לא דווח' and 'עוד לא דווח'
'אין' in the fee column is unexplained
'כללי' is both a filter showing all tracks and a tag on single tracks
The first company's name (and another company's) was never seen because the screen jumped
No cost in shekels for the fee differences
No return after fees (everything is before fees and tax)
No information on what happens at 67 when withdrawing
No guidance on how to move money or what moving costs
No plain explanation of what the 60-plus tracks contain or whether they get safer with age
No worst-year or loss information per track
No information on service or company reliability
No single list of only the 60-plus tracks across companies in fee order
Would drop the 'בניהול אישי / IRA' rows as irrelevant
Would drop tiny tracks with 0–2 million ₪
Would drop the other product buttons from this page

problems.why: The reader is worried that the data hasn't been updated since September and that the dates disagree; that is the same stale-data problem the person named at the top of the page.
